mapper.select: SELECT id, path, is_dir, size_bytes, revision, content_md5, content_sha256, created_at, updated_at FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND path = #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT f.revision, CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END AS text_indexed, COUNT(c.id)::int AS chunk_count, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL)::int AS stored_vector_chunks, COUNT(c.id) FILTER ( WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding_fingerprint = #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )::int AS vector_chunks FROM files f LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.file_id = f.id AND d.source_revision = f.revision LEFT JOIN document_chunks c ON c.document_id = d.id AND c.source_revision = f.revision WHERE f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND f.path = #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND f.is_dir = false GROUP BY f.id, f.revision, d.id

SELECT d.id::text AS document_id, d.source_revision, d.extractor_version, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.updated_at) AS updated, c.id::text AS chunk_id, c.chunk_index, c.chunk_version, c.source_revision AS chunk_source_revision, LEFT(c.content, 4000) AS content, char_length(c.content)::int AS content_length, (c.embedding IS NOT NULL) AS stored_vector, (c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding_fingerprint = #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS current_vector, c.embedding_fingerprint FROM files f LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.file_id = f.id AND d.source_revision = f.revision LEFT JOIN document_chunks c ON c.document_id = d.id AND c.source_revision = d.source_revision WHERE f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND f.path = #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND f.is_dir = false ORDER BY c.chunk_index ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, path, is_dir, size_bytes, revision, content_md5, content_sha256, created_at, updated_at FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND path LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') ORDER BY is_dir DESC, lower(path)

SELECT path, is_dir, size_bytes FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND path IN
#{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO files(user_id, path, is_dir, size_bytes) VALUES (CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isDir}, #{size}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, path) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, is_dir = EXCLUDED.is_dir, size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO files(user_id, path, is_dir, size_bytes) VALUES
(CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{item.path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.isDir}, #{item.size})
ON CONFLICT (user_id, path) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, is_dir = EXCLUDED.is_dir, size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO files(user_id, path, is_dir, size_bytes, content_md5, content_sha256) VALUES (CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, false, #{size}, #{md5}, #{sha256}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, path) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, is_dir = false, size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, revision = files.revision + 1, content_md5 = EXCLUDED.content_md5, content_sha256 = EXCLUDED.content_sha256, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO file_revisions(file_id, revision, size_bytes, content_md5, content_sha256) SELECT id, revision, #{size}, #{md5}, #{sha256} FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND path = #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ON CONFLICT (file_id, revision) DO UPDATE SET size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, content_md5 = EXCLUDED.content_md5, content_sha256 = EXCLUDED.content_sha256
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND (path = #{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR path LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '/%'))
mapper.select: SELECT content_md5, path, file_revision, verified, updated_at FROM upload_dedup WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND content_md5 = #{md5, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND verified = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_dedup(user_id, content_md5, path, file_revision, verified) VALUES (CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{md5, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{revision}, #{verified}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, content_md5) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, path = EXCLUDED.path, file_revision = EXCLUDED.file_revision, verified = EXCLUDED.verified, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO trash_entries(trash_id, user_id, original_path, stored_path, file_revision) VALUES (CAST(#{trashId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{originalPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{storedPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{revision})
mapper.select: SELECT trash_id, original_path, stored_path, file_revision, deleted_at, expires_at FROM trash_entries WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ORDER BY deleted_at DESC

SELECT trash_id, original_path, stored_path, file_revision, deleted_at, expires_at FROM trash_entries WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND deleted_at < to_timestamp(#{cutoffEpoch}) ORDER BY deleted_at ASC

SELECT trash_id, original_path, stored_path, file_revision, deleted_at, expires_at FROM trash_entries WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND (CAST(trash_id AS text) = #{identifier, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR original_path = #{identifier, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ORDER BY deleted_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trash_entries WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND trash_id = CAST(#{trashId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
DELETE FROM trash_entries WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
